profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer I at American Express
profile.summary: I am a senior software engineer at American Express and graduated from the University of Florida with a Computer Science major and a minor in Entrepreneurship. I am driven and always looking to succeed. I excel in leadership positions and love helping others thrive.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Develop, design, and road map a React web application with reusable components and used a scalable vertx backend to solve key issues for stakeholders and improve the speed at which DevOps could remediate issues in our platform by tracking payments, near real-time, globally across key markets and alerting whenever payment files are mismatched or not reaching the correct end application.
• Facilitate on new projects from the design phase all the way to live traffic as Tech lead for a monitoring application within Money Movement and Banking platforms.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Designed and developed real time application to monitor each microservice in the money movement platform using Elastic Search, Logstash and Kibana which improved logging and alerting on a platform level
• Developed a Python Application built on the Django Framework to Monitor the Payments platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Money Movement - Global Remittance
- Developed new tracking and balancing solution for global payments.
- Developed a real time web application to check money movement.
- Focus on scalable, thread-safe, code for use in high-traffic and real-time use cases.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: Working with machine learning and deep learning to come up with solutions for remittance issues.

positions.title: Test Automation Engineer
positions.description: Was a part of the DTLP program and work as a Test Automation Engineer. I took the role of working with scrum teams and also senior management to create a Digital Dashboard to display the Automation results.

positions.title: Academic Mentor
positions.description:
Chosen to lead a select group of 30 incoming engineering freshman, where I held the responsibility of setting up and grooming their academic futures. 
Tasked to educate students in several major subjects, including calculus and programming, and to demonstrate how to handle the rigorous course load in which they were given.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: I tutored in Chemistry, English, History, Mathematics, French, Spanish, the ACT, and the SAT.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Relay For Life of Greater Heights
volunteerExperiences.description: I enjoyed volunteering at Relay for Life because I knew there was a great cause behind it.

company.name: Relay For Life of Greater Heights
